jobs.description:
As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

In this role, you will support a broad range of accounting activities, including invoice processing, bank bookings, reconciliations, monthly closing, reporting and audit support. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and contribute to improving accounting processes. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Don't hesitate to apply.

Your responsibilities:

• Process sales, purchase and general expense invoices in SAP.
• Perform daily bank bookings, reconciliations and account checks.
• Review and follow up on invoices, open items and DMS workflows.
• Process employee expense claims through SAP.
• Support monthly closing, reporting, accruals and reconciliations.
• Prepare documentation for audits and J-SOX requirements.
• Assist with fixed assets, stock counts and other accounting tasks.
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-processing questions.
• Contribute to process improvements.
• Provide back-up support to the wider accounting team when needed.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.
• Good knowledge of accounting principles.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• Good MS Office/Excel skills.
• Accurate, organized and detail-oriented.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and a strong team player.
• Fluent in English and good knowledge of French and Dutch.

?? Where’s all this happening?

At a company based at Arcelor Mittal (Ghent/Zelzate) – not just any place!They’re experts in packing machines, installations, steel, and more. If it needs wrapping, these folks do it better than bubble wrap.

Jobomschrijving

Looking for a job where your muscles will finally have something to do – and steel will tremble at the sight of you? We’ve got just the thing for you!

Our client is on the hunt for a new team member – a packer with personality, humor, and the guts to face the mighty steel rolls in a three-shift battle. If you're not afraid of a challenge, love to stay active, and see “team” as more than just a word – then you’re exactly who they’re looking for!

Ready to roll?

Click, apply, and pack your future with us – strong, stable, and well-paid.

Who are we looking for?

Maybe you, if:

• You’re in shape – no need to be The Rock, but lifting steel rolls does require more than just clicking a mouse ??,
• Shifts? Three? You’re in – no whining, no problem,
• You take safety seriously (a forklift is not a race car ?),
• Small talk is your superpower – you feel like a fish in water speaking Dutch or English.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a complex retail and logistics environment. Technology plays a central role in supporting business operations, and the company is investing in delivering a high-quality IT support experience to its internal users.The position is based in the Dilbeek area.

As an IT Service Desk Support Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

• Acting as the first point of contact for IT incidents and service requests.
• Logging, categorizing, prioritizing, and managing tickets through the ITSM platform.
• Performing first-line troubleshooting and resolving technical issues whenever possible.
• Supporting end-user devices, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and standard business applications.
• Assisting users with Microsoft 365 tools, Windows environments, user account administration, and connectivity issues.
• Managing and monitoring tickets through to resolution while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Escalating incidents to second-line support teams, external providers, or specialist teams when required.
• Following up on escalated incidents and ensuring timely resolution.
• Documenting solutions, workarounds, and recurring incidents to enrich the knowledge base.
• Collaborating with IT colleagues to improve processes, service quality, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will possess:

• Professional proficiency in French and Dutch, both written and spoken.
• A working knowledge of English for internal communication.
• Previous experience in IT support, service desk, helpdesk, or end-user support functions.
• Exposure to several of the following technologies:
• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
• Windows environments and first-level troubleshooting
• Active Directory and user administration
• Networking and connectivity fundamentals
• End-user hardware and peripherals
• Mobile device support
• Strong customer service and communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with a structured approach to ticket management.
• Analytical problem-solving capabilities and the ability to prioritize effectively.
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a genuine desire to develop technical skills further.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and develop customer relationships across Eastern Europe.Our client is an international wholesaler specialising in industrial sealing solutions, including O-rings, technical seals and customised sealing products. The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system. 
• Develop an understanding of customer applications, market developments and competitors. 
• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
• Good physical fitness.
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

• Translate architectural standards and business needs into concrete functional and technical requirements for data flows.
• Define data definitions and KPIs within a semantic layer to ensure consistent reporting across the organization.
• Implement and automate data quality rules to detect and resolve inconsistencies in completeness and accuracy.
• Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes to provide a reliable publication layer for various business intelligence tools.
• Set up and manage CI/CD pipelines for data models and reports to ensure controlled releases.
• Monitor batch processes and data loads while ensuring compliance with data governance and security policies.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
• You possess 2+ years of experience working in a development team utilizing CI/CD workflows.
• You have expert-level knowledge of SQL and data modeling methodologies such as Kimball, Data Vault, and SCD.
• You have experience with ETL/ELT processes and batch processing.
• You're proficient with version control and CI/CD tools including Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
• You possess knowledge of BI tools and semantic layers such as Power BI, SAS Visual Analytics, or Apache Superset.
• You bring experience with data quality and testing automation using tools like dbt tests.
• You have experience working with Jira or Azure Boards.
• You're analytical, accurate, and proactive within complex environments.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with functional English and a passive understanding of the other national language.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as DAMA CDMP, Azure Data Engineer, or Databricks.
• Experience with Python, dbt, Docker, or Azure.
• Knowledge of SAS 9.4, including Base SAS, Enterprise Guide, and DI Studio.
• Previous experience working within a public sector organization.

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?

• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Forklift certification required.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

Company Activities:

Our client is known for its open and jovial atmosphere, characterized by a genuine worker culture and a sense of humor. The facility, located in a bustling logistics hub, includes warehouses that can experience temperature fluctuations when trucks are docked. They pride themselves on fostering a team-oriented environment where every member contributes to collective success.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic team at Site Zeebrugge? Our client is currently seeking Reachtruck Operators who will play a critical role in their logistics operations. As a Reachtruck Operator, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth movement and storage of goods within the facility.

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate reachtrucks efficiently to pick and transport goods (96% of the time).
• Handle manual tasks with a hands-on mentality, including unloading items that may have fallen.
• Scan racks to ensure accurate inventory tracking before and after moving items.
• Occasionally assist in other tasks such as repositioning racks.

Profile Description:

Our client is looking for candidates who are either experienced Reachtruck Operators or possess a valid reachtruck certificate. You will have the opportunity to earn an internal certificate upon completing their training program. Language proficiency in Dutch, English, or French is required to ensure smooth communication within their multicultural team.

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

Jobomschrijving

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

• Our client is a leading European consumer services organization operating across multiple international markets.
• Recognized for its customer-centric approach, the company continuously invests in service excellence, operational efficiency and process improvement.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor and assess customer interactions and service quality performance to identify trends, gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Design, coordinate and manage customer experience assessment programs, including quality audits and mystery shopping initiatives across multiple countries.
• Analyze customer feedback, operational performance metrics and quality data to support informed decision-making. 
• Map and evaluate customer journeys across channels, identifying friction points and recommending practical improvement actions.
• Collaborate with operational and regional stakeholders to support the implementation of service quality and customer experience initiatives.
• Prepare insightful reports, dashboards and presentations for leadership teams, translating data into clear business recommendations.

• Bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Operational Excellence, Business Analysis or a related field.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and transform insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
• Able to work autonomously in a cross-functional environment.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Flexible to travel across Europe (approximately 20%).

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

As a (Senior) Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

A successful (Senior) Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Veterinary Sales Representative - Brussels & Waals Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a global organization active in animal health, supporting veterinary professionals through innovative products and solutions aimed at improving the well-being of companion animals.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Sales Representative - Brussels & Walloon Brabant - FR/DU, your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute territory and account plans to achieve sales targets
• Build long-term relationships with veterinary clinics, veterinarians and KOL in the animal health industry in Brussels & Walloon Brabant
• Promote animal health pharma products through face-to-face and virtual interactions with veterinarians
• Identify growth opportunities within existing and new veterinary clinics in Brussels & Walloon Brabant

• Maintain accurate CRM reporting and territory insights

As a successful  Veterinary Sales Representative - Brussels & Walloon Brabant - FR/DU, you have the following profile

•   3 years of sales experiences in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical devices or animal health
• Previous experiences as Medical representative or veterinary sales representative
• Strong account management and relationship-building capabilities

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

Jobomschrijving

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.

• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.

• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.
 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.
